name: runtime_vote_account
description: One row per vote account per epoch boundary: the per-account vote-cache snapshot taken as the boundary is crossed

bank_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number identifying this block within the current run; the join key to runtime_block. Restarts at 1 each time a snapshot is loaded, so pair it with the stream's boot id. 0 means unavailable.

slot.description: First replayed slot of the new epoch

epoch.description: The new epoch being entered; the snapshot captures this account's stake as of the end of epoch - 1

stake.description: Effective stake delegated to this vote account at this boundary

commission_bps.description: Commission read from the vote account at this boundary (basis points)

has_commission_t_2.description: True if the account existed in the snapshot taken one boundary earlier

commission_t_2_bps.description: Commission recorded one boundary earlier (0 unless has_commission_t_2)

has_commission_t_3.description: True if the account existed in the snapshot taken two boundaries earlier

commission_t_3_bps.description: Commission recorded two boundaries earlier (0 unless has_commission_t_3)

reward_commission_bps.description: Commission the reward calculation will actually use for this epoch's vote rewards: the oldest available of t-3 / t-2 / current when delay_commission_updates is active, current otherwise

credits.description: Cumulative vote credits at this boundary

prev_credits.description: Cumulative vote credits at the start of the latest epoch-credits ladder entry

epoch_credits_cnt.description: Entries in the vote account's epoch-credits ladder at this boundary
